title: WGPU Stroke Dash Shadow Conformance Harness Follow-on v1
problem: Several stroke, dash, and rounded-shadow WGPU conformance tests still duplicated the same Rgba8Unorm final-render readback helpers already owned by the shared integration-test support module. The duplication made renderer contract evidence noisy without adding coverage.

repro.summary: Stroke, dash, and shadow WGPU conformance tests should render and sample through shared test support while preserving Rgba8Unorm transparent-clear behavior and scale-factor coverage.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test dashed_border_conformance --test dash_semantics_rrect_vs_path_conformance --test stroke_paint_conformance --test shadow_rrect_conformance -j 1

gates.name: stroke-dash-shadow-conformance
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test dashed_border_conformance --test dash_semantics_rrect_vs_path_conformance --test stroke_paint_conformance --test shadow_rrect_conformance -j 1

continue_policy.notes: The named stroke, dash, and shadow tests migrated successfully. Effect, text, image, viewport, Vulkan, and MSAA test helper cleanup should stay in separate one-family follow-ons because their target setup or semantics may differ.
